question: What claim is made about a teaching concerning the earth-movers and good eaters being told, and by whom?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-movers and the good eaters is posited.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: A teaching concerning the earth-movers and the good eaters is presented as having been told by an earth-mover to the beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: A teaching concerning the earth-movers and the good eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
